rationale: The 8.8 overview renames the SOC workflow Triage and Response and retains Cloud ES 8.6+ versus task-guide ES 8.7+ and Platform 10.2+; both retain paired SOAR. CMP guide and overview both specify Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The 8.7 task is historical. The 8.8 task still requires enablement, existing triaged finding, frontier models, investigation/connector permissions, asset roles and its per-detection/tenant limits. ES release notes now document November 4 GA. Edition and compatibility tables remain separate from exact pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement and authorization.

products: Splunk Enterprise Security AI SOC Analyst
versions: ES 8.8 documentation: aggregate Cloud ES 8.6+ versus task-specific ES 8.7+
audiences: Readers planning AI SOC Analyst prerequisites
exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.

remainingConcerns: ES 8.8 GA and current Triage and Response naming do not resolve the aggregate 8.6+ and task-specific 8.7+ Cloud prerequisite discrepancy. ES Editions Watch owns canonical reconciliation.
